milestone: First required paper target evaluated at one exact epsilon sample with automatic boundaries and norm-based precision/order stability
scope: One target at epsilon1/2700. Not a Laurent reconstruction, not all four required targets, not an upstream-reference comparison, and not cold-run timing.

source.dependency_provenance: Cargo.lock and repository dependency metadata at the recorded source commit; sibling RustRed was not modified for this run.

input.warm_start_note: Prior exact IBP search work is reused. The separate derivative reductions and recursive preparations are included in this continuation; preparation before the input checkpoint is excluded.

configuration.boundary_precision_policy: RecursiveBoundary derives precision and increased series order from each requested Precision; exact prepared subflows are memoized while numerical values are separated by precision.

result.criterion: Precision::close: norm(first-second) <= 10^-20 * max(1,norm(first)), evaluated at refined precision. This is a complex norm-based check, not separate20-digit certification of each component.
result.observed: The example completed its independent increased precision/order pass and printed the success marker. The first-pass value and numerical difference were not printed, so no error estimate beyond that pass/fail criterion is recorded.

observed_workflow.automatic_path: Native exact derivative closure, infinity Frobenius and dimensional sectors, rank-selected region coefficients, recursively evaluated/batched factors, continuation, endpoint Frobenius and target projection, then increased precision/order evaluation.

timing.methodology: Progress-event receipt times and enclosing subprocess wall clock from the existing runner. Intervals are phase bounds, not separate instrumented kernel timers. Prepared-to-final-value includes both numerical passes, recursive boundaries, transport and endpoint matching. Other host work was active; no speedup comparison is inferred.

acceptance_remaining: Evaluate all four required targets across the epsilon sample sets, reconstruct coefficients through epsilon^0, compare each coefficient against upstream data respecting recorded precision, and pass independent sample/precision/order refinement.
